propositions.name: action_at_distance_phenomenon
propositions.statement: Bodies in certain electric or magnetic states can set each other in motion while still at a sensible distance from each other.
propositions.quote: bodies in certain states set each other in motion while still at a sensible distance from each other

propositions.name: force_depends_on_position_and_condition
propositions.statement: The force between bodies depends in a certain way upon the relative position of the bodies and on their electric or magnetic condition.
propositions.quote: this force depends in a certain way upon the relative position of the bodies and on their electric or magnetic condition

propositions.name: field_theory_matter_in_motion
propositions.statement: In the space in the neighbourhood of electric or magnetic bodies there is matter in motion, by which the observed electromagnetic phenomena are produced.
propositions.quote: it assumes that in that space there is matter in motion, by which the observed electromagnetic phenomena are produced

propositions.name: field_definition
propositions.statement: The electromagnetic field is that part of space which contains and surrounds bodies in electric or magnetic conditions.
propositions.quote: The electromagnetic field is that part of space which contains and surrounds bodies in electric or magnetic conditions

propositions.name: field_can_be_vacuum
propositions.statement: The electromagnetic field may be rendered empty of all gross matter, as in the case of vacua.
propositions.quote: we may endeavour to render it empty of all gross matter, as in the case of Geissler

propositions.name: ether_transmits_light_and_heat
propositions.statement: Even when a space is rendered a vacuum, enough matter is left to receive and transmit the undulations of light and heat.
propositions.quote: There is always, however, enough of matter left to receive and transmit the undulations of light and heat

propositions.name: undulations_are_ethereal_not_gross
propositions.statement: The undulations of light and heat are undulations of an ethereal substance, and not of the gross matter.
propositions.quote: we are obliged to admit that the undulations are those of an ethereal substance, and not of the gross matter

propositions.name: ether_pervades_space_and_bodies
propositions.statement: There is an ethereal medium filling space and permeating bodies, capable of being set in motion and of transmitting that motion from one part to another.
propositions.quote: there is an ethereal medium filling space and permeating bodies, capable of being set in motion and of transmitting that motion from one part to another

propositions.name: ether_communicates_motion_as_heat
propositions.statement: The medium can communicate motion to gross matter so as to heat it and affect it in various ways.
propositions.quote: communicating that motion to gross matter so as to heat it and affect it in various ways

propositions.name: energy_preexists_in_medium
propositions.statement: The energy communicated to a body in heating it must have formerly existed in the moving medium.
propositions.quote: the energy communicated to the body in heating it must have formerly existed in the moving medium

propositions.name: ether_has_real_density
propositions.statement: There exists a pervading medium of small but real density, capable of being set in motion.
propositions.quote: the existence of a pervading medium of small but real density, capable of being set in motion

propositions.name: finite_velocity_of_transmission
propositions.statement: The medium transmits motion from one part to another with great, but not infinite, velocity.
propositions.quote: of transmitting motion from one part to another with great, but not infinite, velocity

propositions.name: medium_parts_connected
propositions.statement: The parts of the medium must be so connected that the motion of one part depends in some way on the motion of the rest.
propositions.quote: the parts of this medium must be so connected that the motion of one part depends in some way on the motion of the rest

propositions.name: connections_capable_of_elastic_yielding
propositions.statement: The connections of the medium must be capable of a certain kind of elastic yielding, since the communication of motion is not instantaneous but occupies time.
propositions.quote: these connections must be capable of a certain kind of elastic yielding, since the communication of motion is not instantaneous, but occupies time

propositions.name: two_forms_of_energy_in_medium
propositions.statement: The medium is capable of receiving and storing up two kinds of energy, namely actual energy depending on the motions of its parts, and potential energy.
propositions.quote: capable of receiving and storing up two kinds of energy, namely, the “actual” energy depending on the motions of its parts, and “potential” energy

propositions.name: magnetism_acts_on_luminiferous_medium
propositions.statement: The luminiferous medium is in certain cases acted on by magnetism.
propositions.quote: the luminiferous medium is in certain cases acted on by magnetism

propositions.name: faraday_rotation_effect
propositions.statement: When a plane polarized ray traverses a transparent diamagnetic medium in the direction of the lines of magnetic force, the plane of polarization is caused to rotate.
propositions.quote: when a plane polarized ray traverses a transparent diamagnetic medium in the direction of the lines of magnetic force produced by magnets or currents in the neighbourhood, the plane of polarization is caused to rotate

propositions.name: paramagnetic_reverses_rotation_direction
propositions.statement: If a paramagnetic body is substituted for the diamagnetic body, the rotation of the plane of polarization is in the opposite direction.
propositions.quote: if a paramagnetic body, such as solution of perchloride of iron in ether, be substituted for the diamagnetic body, the rotation is in the opposite direction

propositions.name: magnetization_is_motion_in_medium
propositions.statement: There is a motion in the medium depending on the magnetization, in addition to the vibratory motion which constitutes light.
propositions.quote: we must admit the existence of a motion in the medium depending on the magnetization, in addition to the vibratory motion which constitutes light

propositions.name: magnetic_motion_is_rotation_on_axis
propositions.statement: The motion of the medium associated with magnetism is one of rotation, having the direction of the magnetic force as its axis.
propositions.quote: this motion is one of rotation, having the direction of the magnetic force as its axis

propositions.name: motion_across_lines_produces_emf
propositions.statement: When a body is moved across the lines of magnetic force it experiences what is called an electromotive force.
propositions.quote: When a body is moved across the lines of magnetic force it experiences what is called an electromotive force

propositions.name: emf_electrifies_extremities_and_drives_current
propositions.statement: Under electromotive force the two extremities of a body tend to become oppositely electrified, and an electric current tends to flow through the body.
propositions.quote: the two extremities of the body tend to become oppositely electrified, and an electric current tends to flow through the body

propositions.name: components_have_natural_tendency_to_combine
propositions.statement: The components of a decomposed compound body have a natural tendency to combine, and combining generates an electromotive force in the reverse direction.
propositions.quote: their natural tendency is to combine, and to combine with a force which can generate an electromotive force in the reverse direction

propositions.name: electric_polarization_is_constraint_state
propositions.statement: Electric polarization is a state of constraint in which opposite extremities are oppositely electrified, and from which the body tends to relieve itself as soon as the disturbing force is removed.
propositions.quote: a state of constraint in which opposite extremities are oppositely electrified, and from which the body tends to relieve itself as soon as the disturbing force is removed

propositions.name: emf_is_force_of_medium_motion_transfer
propositions.statement: Electromotive force is the force called into play during the communication of motion from one part of the medium to another.
propositions.quote: this "electromotive force" is the force called into play during the communication of motion from one part of the medium to another

propositions.name: resistance_heat_is_irreversible
propositions.statement: The transformation of electrical energy into heat by resistance is incapable of being restored again to the form of electrical energy by a reversal of the process.
propositions.quote: occasions a continual transformation of electrical energy into heat, which is incapable of being restored again to the form of electrical energy by an reversal of the process

propositions.name: dielectric_polarization_analogous_to_magnetic
propositions.statement: Electromotive force acting on a dielectric produces a state of polarization of its parts similar in distribution to the polarity of the parts of a mass of iron under the influence of a magnet.
propositions.quote: electromotive force acts on a dielectric it produces a state of polarization of its parts similar in distribution to the polarity of the parts of a mass of iron under the influence of a magnet

propositions.name: displaced_electricity_stays_with_molecule
propositions.statement: In a dielectric the displaced electricity remains entirely connected with the molecule, and does not pass from one molecule to another.
propositions.quote: the electricity remains entirely connected with the molecule, and does not pass from one molecule to another

propositions.name: variations_of_displacement_constitute_currents
propositions.statement: Electric displacement is the commencement of a current, and its variations constitute currents in the positive or negative direction according as the displacement is increasing or decreasing.
propositions.quote: it is the commencement of a current, and its variations constitute currents in the positive or the negative direction according as the displacement is increasing or decreasing

propositions.name: dielectric_material_affects_displacement_amount
propositions.statement: The same electromotive force generally produces a greater electric displacement in solid dielectrics, such as glass or sulphur, than in air.
propositions.quote: the same electromotive force producing generally a greater electric displacement in solid dielectrics, such as glass or sulphur, than in air

propositions.name: dielectrics_have_conductivity
propositions.statement: The dielectric has a conductivity which, though in many cases exceedingly small, is not altogether insensible.
propositions.quote: the conductivity of the dielectric, which, though in many cases exceedingly small, is not altogether insensible

propositions.name: electric_absorption_delays_return_to_state
propositions.statement: When the electromotive force is removed, a dielectric exhibiting electric absorption does not instantly return to its primitive state, but only discharges a portion of its electrification.
propositions.quote: when the electromotive force is removed, the dielectric does not instantly return to its primitive state, but only discharges a portion of its electrification

propositions.name: currents_connected_only_via_field_magnetization
propositions.statement: Two currents are put in connexion with each other only in virtue of their connexion with the magnetization of the field.
propositions.quote: the two currents are put in connexion with each other in virtue of their connexion with the magnetization of the field

propositions.name: no_direct_action_at_sensible_distances
propositions.statement: The action between distant bodies can be explained without assuming the existence of forces capable of acting directly at sensible distances.
propositions.quote: endeavouring to explain the action between distant bodies without assuming the existence of forces capable of acting directly at sensible distances

propositions.name: medium_mechanism_obeys_dynamics
propositions.statement: The mechanism of the medium must be subject to the general laws of Dynamics.
propositions.quote: Such a mechanism must be subject to the general laws of Dynamics

propositions.name: total_current_compounded_of_displacement_and_conduction
propositions.statement: The total current is compounded of electric displacement and true conduction.
propositions.quote: The relation between electric displacement, true conduction, and the total current, compounded of both

propositions.name: propagated_magnetic_disturbances_are_transverse_only
propositions.statement: The only disturbances which can be propagated through a non-conductive field are those which are transverse to the direction of propagation.
propositions.quote: the only disturbances which can be so propagated are those which are transverse to the direction of propagation

propositions.name: propagation_velocity_is_velocity_v
propositions.statement: The velocity of propagation of a magnetic disturbance is the velocity v, found from experiments such as those of Weber.
propositions.quote: the velocity of propagation is the velocity v , found from experiments such as those of Weber

propositions.name: light_is_electromagnetic_disturbance
propositions.statement: Light itself, including radiant heat and other radiations, is an electromagnetic disturbance in the form of waves propagated through the electromagnetic field according to electromagnetic laws.
propositions.quote: light itself (including radiant heat, and other radiations if any) is an electromagnetic disturbance in the form of waves propagated through the electromagnetic field according to electromagnetic laws

propositions.name: refraction_index_relates_to_capacities
propositions.statement: The square of the index of refraction is equal to the product of the specific dielectric capacity and the specific magnetic capacity.
propositions.quote: the square of the index of refraction is equal to the product of the specific dielectric capacity and the specific magnetic capacity

propositions.name: conducting_media_are_opaque
propositions.statement: Conducting media absorb radiations rapidly and are therefore generally opaque.
propositions.quote: Conducting media are shown to absorb such radiations rapidly, and therefore to be generally opaque
